title: fix(fields,components): a cascade-cleared single select or radio is saved as null (objectui#10291)
body:
Fixes #10291
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

A cascade clear empties an option field when its parent changes and the current value is no longer offered. For a single select or a radio, the clear emptied the field to `undefined`. The JSON transport leaves out an own key whose value is `undefined`: `@objectstack/client`'s `data.update` sends `body: JSON.stringify(data)`. So the field the user saw emptied was never written, and the stored value came back on refresh. The multi-value clear wrote a real `[]` and was saved.

## Measured first, on `origin/main` `94436f42a`, with the new pins (before any edit)

Both pins read the **wire body**, not the `update` argument:
- the inline-edit pin serialises the body the same way the client does;
- the form pin runs the real `@object-ui/data-objectstack` adapter and `@objectstack/client`, with only `fetch` stubbed.

| Path | Body on `main` |
|---|---|
| Inline edit (real `DetailSection` + `InlineEditSaveBar`), parent moved | `{ region: 'apac', tags: [] }`. `tier` and `band` are missing. |
| `ObjectForm` edit, parent moved | `region`, `tags: []`, `tier_any`. `tier` and `band` are missing. |
| `ObjectForm` create, parent moved | `{ region: 'apac', tags: [] }`. `tier` and `band` are missing. |

⇒ The form path loses the value too: premise and reach both confirmed.

## The fix, and why this route

The fix is on the widget side, as the seat suggested. The measurement then required one more edit in the same file family.

1. `SelectField` / `RadioField` cascade clear: `onChange(undefined)` becomes `onChange(null)`. One change covers inline edit, `ObjectForm` and every other host.
2. The form renderer's own cascade clear (`packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`): `setValue(name, undefined)` becomes `setValue(name, null)`. This clear runs independently of the widgets. With only step 1 applied, one case was still measured red: an `ObjectForm` edit whose dependent select is hidden by `visibleWhen`, so no widget is mounted. The form host clears that field alone, and the PATCH body still lacked `tier`. The built-in `select` branch is the same case, because it has no widget clear. The clear-on-hide effect in the same file already writes `null`, for the reason it documents (objectui#6958 / objectui#6848): an explicit `null` clears the stored value and an absent key leaves it unchanged.
3. `SelectField` renders a `null` value as "nothing chosen" (next section).

I did not use the save-path mapping (map an own `undefined` to `null` on the inline and form save paths). The widgets are where the wrong value is made. Fixing them is one change for every host, where the mapping needs two changes and misses hosts it does not know.

## What `null` does downstream (the four checks)

- **Required validation.** `isMissingForRequired` (`@object-ui/core`) counts `undefined` and `null` as absent. Nothing changes. (Code read.)
- **Dirty tracking.** The inline draft holds the key, so it is sent. The master-detail diff (`isSameStoredValue`) counts `null` and `undefined` as one blank, so a pruned field (`gold` becomes `null`) is dirty. The form host clear still passes `shouldDirty: true`.
- **The widget's display of `null`.** Measured in the form: a raw `null` gave the select trigger empty text and no `data-placeholder`. It never showed the text "null", but the placeholder disappeared. The widget now absorbs this: `null` is passed to Radix as `''`, the controlled spelling of "nothing chosen". `undefined` is left alone so that no host changes between controlled and uncontrolled. `RadioField` already rendered `value ?? ''`. Pinned in `SelectField.clearedNull-10291`.
- **Whether `null` is accepted on write for a select.** This relies on the write contract documented beside the clear-on-hide effect (objectui#6848: `driver-memory` merges, `driver-sql` issues `SET` for present keys). It was ⛔ NOT MEASURED against a live server in this PR.

## Pins (all read the wire body)

- (a) Inline edit, `InlineEditSaveBar.cascadePruneWire-10291`. After the parent moves, the body is exactly `{ region: 'apac', tier: null, band: null, tags: [] }`.
- (b) Form, `plugin-form` `cascadePruneWire-10291`:
  - EDIT: `tier: null` and `band: null`;
  - EDIT with no widget mounted (host-only clear): `tier: null`;
  - CREATE: `tier: null` and `band: null`.
- (c) Control: the multi select still writes `tags: []` on both paths.
- (d) Control: a select no parent governs is never nulled.
  - Inline edit: it is absent from the body.
  - Create form: it is absent.
  - Edit form: it is present with its stored `'gold'`, because an edit form sends its whole value set today. "Only dirty" is objectui#10156, which this PR does not address.
- Existing prune pins change from `undefined` to `null`:
  - the four `@object-ui/fields` widget suites and the objectui#6153 one;
  - the two components host suites (`form-cascade-clear-prefixed-type`, `form-gated-options-keep-value`);
  - the app-shell action-dialog one;
  - the objectui#7190 prune probe. It now counts `null` and `undefined` prunes, so a regression still trips its circuit breaker instead of hanging the run.

## Ablation (tests resolve `@object-ui/fields` / `@object-ui/components` to `src` through the root vitest aliases, so no build sits between the mutation and the run)

Each leg ran through `ablation-replace.mjs` (wrap mode, restore trap) at `11a8bbcd6`:
- **Leg 1, widgets back to `undefined`** (both files, anchor x1 → x0 each). Result: `Tests 7 failed | 9 passed`. Red: pin (a), form EDIT, form CREATE, and 4 widget cascade pins. The form host-only case stayed green, as expected for a clear the widgets do not own.
- **Leg 2, form host clear back to `undefined`.** Result: `Tests 6 failed | 9 passed`. Red: the host-only form pin and 5 components host pins. The inline pin and the mounted-form pins stayed green. The first launch of this leg was refused by the tool before any write ("ANCHOR AMBIGUOUS", x2, because the clear-on-hide line is identical). It was a no-op, and I re-ran it with a unique two-line anchor.
- **Restore, both legs.** Blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty, per the tool's own verdict lines.

## Verification (at `11a8bbcd6`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/ packages/plugin-detail/ packages/plugin-form/ packages/components/src/renderers/form/` from the repo root, plus these files:
  - the app-shell tests that exercise option cascades;
  - the plugin-grid and plugin-list tests that exercise option cascades;
  - `apps/console` `FormPage.*`.
  - Result: `Test Files 598 passed | 2 skipped (600)`, `Tests 7052 passed | 26 skipped (7078)`.
- `type-check`, after `turbo run build` of the dependency closure: `@object-ui/fields`, `components`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-form`, `app-shell` all `Done`. The touched test files are in each package's `tsconfig.test.json` program (`--listFilesOnly`).
- `check:control-bytes` OK. `check:new-line-citations` reported `0 new citation(s)`. `check-changeset-presence` ✅. `check:changeset-claims` exit 0.
  - `check:changeset-claims` flagged 3 pending changesets that name `form.tsx`. I read each one, and each is about an unrelated part of that file: the FormPage chain, `section-divider` `className`, and `description` wiring. None is falsified.
- More checks that passed: `check:vi-mock-*` ×3, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, and the governed-surface test (NOT GOVERNED). `check:doc-snippets` was ⛔ NOT MEASURED: its prerequisite is a whole-tree build, which is left to CI.
- ESLint over the 15 touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files (`--format json`), compared with base through `--stdin`: 0 errors. `no-explicit-any` warnings went from 121 to 133. All +12 are in the two new test files, and they are the same `as any` host-prop casts as the neighbouring suites. `react-refresh` 7 → 7, `no-unused-vars` 1 → 1.

## Scope note: the claim's file surface was exceeded (flagged, not settled here)

The claim named the two widgets, the tests beside them, `InlineEditSaveBar` if needed, and one changeset. This PR also touches these files:
- `form.tsx` and its two host suites (the measured form-path gap above);
- two app-shell tests that pin the old `undefined`;
- one sentence in `content/docs/fields/select.mdx`.

When the edits were made:
- no open PR (14 read) touched `form.tsx`;
- no live claim (21 read) named it.

The seat decides whether to accept this surface or split it off.

## Acceptance notes

- `FieldWidgetComponentProps.onChange` is typed `(val: T) => void`, so every clearing widget casts its `null` (`null as unknown as string`, `onChange(null as any)`). Not changed here, because that would change an exported signature.
- Hosts that pass `SelectField` a `value` that turns into `undefined` still switch Radix from controlled to uncontrolled. The cascade clear no longer causes that switch.

## Changeset

`.changeset/10291-cleared-scalar-saves-null.md`: `minor` on `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/components`, because a cleared value is now saved.
